title: Round 15: net2 on net1 v6 with more copies in training, and warm-started from round 12
description: Round 12's checkpoints matched the fixed rule on every validation family without beating it beyond the noise (exp-net2-eval-r12-155: five-family mean -0.002 and +0.004, cubic-first-60 +0.042 and +0.026 with intervals including 0), and lost 0.10 to 0.12 as copies, with intervals of -0.41 to +0.20. Two arms on net1 v6 (release exp-net1v6-149, its rule at u = 0.25), each next to round 14 (the same learner and mixture, from the rule): copies: more copies in training, competition on 60% of the links (half of it 2 or 4 copies with the team reward, so copies on 30% against round 14's 20%) and the flow alone on 35%; warm: round 12's rule arm, actor and critic (release model-net2-r12-cands, by seed), continued on v6 with round 14's mixture (alone 0.4, compete 0.4), to see whether what it learned on v5's beliefs carries over and shortens training. 30 s episodes, tau 1 s, seeds 1 to 3, 120 iterations. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r15-$ARM-s$SEED.json"; A="$IN/a/ppo-r12-rule-s$SEED"; jq --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg actor "$A.actor.pt" --arg critic "$A.critic.pt" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | (if $arm == "copies" then .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 else .alone = 0.4 | .compete = 0.4 | .init_actor = $actor | .init_critic = $critic end)' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r15-$ARM-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
